source: Codex Adeptus Custodes, 11th edition + V2 points table

items.name: Bane of Abominations
items.t: Attacks that target an enemy CHARACTER/MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 to wound.

items.name: Emperor’s Light
items.t: Gains Emperor’s Light [EXTRA ATTACKS]: Melee, A3, WS2+, S5, AP-2, D2.

items.name: Castellan’s Mark
items.t: After deployment: redeploy up to 3 friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units, possibly into strategic reserves.

items.name: Eagle’s Eye
items.t: +1 W. Once per battle, per army: 3+ InSv ability when attacks are allocated (wording to be checked against the codex).

items.name: Genalchemic Warding
items.t: Feel No Pain 5+.

items.name: Unstoppable Destroyer
items.t: Pile-in/consolidation up to 4", any consolidation mode regardless of Before Moving restrictions.

items.name: Sally Forth
items.t: Start of your Charge phase: one friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit within 6" of this model; if it advanced this turn, that advance does not prevent it from declaring a charge.

items.name: Auric Eagle
items.t: Unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls (INFANTRY/MOUNTED, not TERMINATOR).

items.name: Pareldor’s Caducatrix
items.t: Once per battle, per army, at the start of any phase: heals D3+3 wounds.

items.name: Not a Shell Wasted
items.t: The unit’s ranged attacks have +1 A.

items.name: Auric Exemplar
items.t: Melee attacks have [CLEAVE 1].

items.name: Flawless Bladework
items.t: Melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

items.name: Auriferous Orb
items.t: Gains Auriferous Orb: 12", A3, BS2+, S1, AP0, D1 [ANTI-non-MONSTER/VEHICLE 2+, BLINDING LIGHT, DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

items.name: Edge of the Blade
items.t: If the unit charged this turn: re-roll hit rolls and wound rolls of 1.

items.name: Radiant Mantle
items.t: Attacks that target this unit have -1 to hit.

items.name: From the Hall of Armouries
items.t: Melee attacks have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

items.name: Shroud of the Hidden Blade
items.t: Stealth and Lone Operative.

items.name: Inspirational Exemplar
items.t: Once per battle round, per army: a battle-shocked friendly unit within 9" is no longer battle-shocked.

items.name: Superior Creation
items.t: When destroyed, roll D6: on 2+ set it back up unengaged with 3 wounds remaining.

items.name: Arae-Shrike
items.t: Enemy units making an ingress move cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.

items.name: Celeritous Sentries
items.t: Once per phase, per unit: target with Heroic Intervention at -1 CP without blocking other uses.

items.name: Lightning Descent
items.t: In your first Movement phase this unit can make an ingress move.

items.name: Fierce Conqueror
items.t: Once per phase, per army: Rapid Ingress on this unit at -1 CP without blocking other uses.

items.name: Memento Moritoi
items.t: One per army. Melee attacks have +1 A, +1 S and +1 D.

items.name: Augury Uplink
items.t: One per army. Feel No Pain 5+.

items.name: Combat Deployment
items.t: When a unit disembarks from this transport: it can re-roll charge rolls and cannot be targeted by snap shooting.

items.name: Anti-Gravitic Mobility
items.t: A fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot.

items.name: Oblivion Knight
items.t: +1 to hit rolls, or +1 to hit and wound if it targets a PSYKER/battle-shocked unit.

items.name: Huntress’ Eye
items.t: Movement phase: one visible enemy within 12" makes a battle-shock roll with -1.
